english.title: Engage in estate agency work after being adjudged bankrupt
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having

(A)_[been adjudged bankrupt]_
(B)_[had your estate sequestrated in Scotland]_

you engaged in estate agency work other than as an employee of another person
english.legislation: Contrary to section 23(4) of the Estate Agents Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
having been adjudged bankrupt / had estate sequestrated in Scotland engaged in estate agency work other than as an employee of another person

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Ymwneud â gwaith gwerthu tai ar ôl cael eich dyfarnu'n fethdalwr
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) a chithau wedi

(A)_[cael eich dyfarnu'n fethdalwr]_
(B)_[cael eich ystad wedi'i atafaelu yn yr Alban]_

bu i chi ymwneud â gwaith gwerthu tai ar wahân i fel un o weithwyr rhywun arall
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 23(4) Deddf Gwerthwyr Tai 1979.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit on Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
